_readme: Every SMS the hub sends. The hub reads this file; edit wording here, not in code.
Messages to Noor need 'rw' (and 'en'). Messages to coop staff (one person: photos, approvals, follow-ups) can stay English, but 'rw' is drafted too.
Keep {placeholders} exactly as written. One SMS is 160 characters; longer ones split into 2 and cost double.
The Kinyarwanda ('rw') text is a DRAFT written by Claude. Mimi must check and correct every line before use.

noor_likely_bring_leaves.en: FarmFlow: this sounds like {diagnosis}. Please bring 5 affected leaves to {centre} so we can check.
noor_likely_bring_leaves.rw: FarmFlow: birasa na {diagnosis}. Zana amababi 5 arwaye kuri {centre} tuyasuzume.

noor_likely_no_photo.en: FarmFlow: this sounds like {diagnosis}. Dial {ussd} to see inputs you can get on credit.
noor_likely_no_photo.rw: FarmFlow: birasa na {diagnosis}. Kanda {ussd} urebe inyongeramusaruro wahabwa ku nguzanyo.

noor_unsure.en: FarmFlow: we are not sure what this is. Coop staff will contact you. You can also bring leaves to {centre}.
noor_unsure.rw: FarmFlow: ntitwizeye icyo ari cyo. Umukozi wa koperative azaguhamagara. Ushobora no kuzana amababi kuri {centre}.

noor_confirmed.en: FarmFlow: the washing station confirmed {diagnosis}. Your coop is reviewing input credit for you.
noor_confirmed.rw: FarmFlow: isuzuma ryemeje ko ari {diagnosis}. Koperative yawe iri gusuzuma inguzanyo yawe.

noor_credit_ready.en: FarmFlow: your input credit of RWF {limit} is ready. Dial {ussd} to order.
noor_credit_ready.rw: FarmFlow: inguzanyo yawe ya RWF {limit} yabonetse. Kanda {ussd} usabe.

agent_photo_result.en: Leaf: {diagnosis} ({conf}% sure). Suggested: {bundle}. Credit proposal follows.

agent_photo_unsure.en: Not sure ({conf}%). No treatment suggested. Keep the leaves and follow up with the farmer.
agent_photo_unsure.rw: Ntibyizewe ({conf}%). Nta muti dusaba. Bika amababi ukurikirane umuhinzi.

agent_photo_quality.en: Photo {problem}. Please take it again in daylight, leaf filling the frame.
agent_photo_quality.rw: Ifoto: {problem}. Ongera ufotore ku manywa, ibabi ryuzuye ifoto.

agent_help.en: D <id> <kg> [R<rejected kg>] log cherry / L <id> credit status / HELP
agent_help.rw: D <id> <kg> [R<kg zanzwe>] andika ikawa / L <id> inguzanyo / HELP

agent_error.en: Not understood. Try: D F0001 25.5 or L F0001
agent_error.rw: Ntibyumvikanye. Gerageza: D F0001 25.5 cyangwa L F0001

officer_request.en: FarmFlow: {name} {farmer_id}, {diagnosis}. Proposed credit RWF {limit} (low forecast {p10} kg). Reply OK {code} or NO {code}
officer_request.rw: FarmFlow: {name} {farmer_id}, {diagnosis}. Inguzanyo RWF {limit} (umusaruro muke uteganyijwe {p10} kg). Subiza OK {code} cg NO {code}

officer_no_history.en: FarmFlow: {name} {farmer_id} asked for input credit but has under 2 seasons of deliveries. Please follow up.
officer_no_history.rw: FarmFlow: {name} {farmer_id} yasabye inguzanyo ariko afite ibihembwe biri munsi ya 2. Mumukurikirane.

extension_referral.en: FarmFlow: {name} ({village}, {phone}) wrote: {message}. Model not sure. Please follow up.
